comparator.academicYear: 2026–2027; adopted new-programme requirements for entrants from September2026; named supported subset175
comparator.sourceNotes: Current2026–2027 programme-specific OER freshly retrieved through the current official regulatory index on9October2026 supersedes mixed-cohort API membership for formal requirements. Article2.2 explicitly says no specialisations: the prose History/Anthropology, Literature/Film and Linguistics directions are not named formal routes. AppendixF explicitly distinguishes NEW PROGRAM implemented from26–27forward from OLD PROGRAM22–23–25–26. New year1 is60, including SwahiliI10 and SwahiliII10. New year2 replaces old SwahiliII10 with SwahiliIII5 and an additional5-EC position labelled T.B.A.; the outgoing SwahiliII entry is only a resit in semester1 of26–27. Thus the two matching SwahiliII catalogue entries cannot both be counted for the new entrant. New year2 named requirements total55 including digital humanities5, SwahiliIII5, language/culture5, climate/health10, Study in Africa25 and Research in Practice5; the unspecified T.B.A.5 is withheld from the named component list. New year3 is60: genuine discretionary space30, thesis10, AfricaToday10, Anthropological Linguistics5 and African Religions and Philosophies5; the old exactly-one5 choice is not imported. The zero-credit thesis seminar is retained as a noncredit obligation. All corresponding current module weights were freshly fetched; modulecodes/levels for outgoing records do not certify future new-cohort delivery. The supported named subset totals60+55+60=175 and is diagnostic, not a complete valid180 pathway. Article4.2 requires SwahiliI before SwahiliII, SwahiliI/II before SwahiliIII, propaedeutic completion before Study in Africa, and propaedeutic completion/Study in Africa before the thesis. The currentAPI conflicts with the adopted new-programme progression; no unnamed requirement, replacement or credits are invented. No UCR feasibility conclusion is drawn.
